# Vercel AI SDK

Integrate Tavily with Vercel AI SDK to enhance your AI agents with powerful web search, content extraction, crawling, and site mapping capabilities.

## [​](#introduction) Introduction

The `@tavily/ai-sdk` package provides pre-built AI SDK tools for Vercel’s AI SDK v5, making it easy to add real-time web search, content extraction, intelligent crawling, and site mapping to your AI applications.

## [​](#step-by-step-integration-guide) Step-by-Step Integration Guide

### [​](#step-1-install-required-packages) Step 1: Install Required Packages

Install the necessary packages:

```
npm install ai @ai-sdk/openai @tavily/ai-sdk npm  install  ai @ai-sdk/openai @tavily/ai-sdk
```

### [​](#step-2-set-up-api-keys) Step 2: Set Up API Keys

* **Tavily API Key:** [Get your Tavily API key here](https://app.tavily.com/home)
* **OpenAI API Key:** [Get your OpenAI API key here](https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys)

Set these as environment variables:

```
export TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-your-api-key export  TAVILY_API_KEY =tvly-your-api-keyexport OPENAI_API_KEY=your-openai-api-key export  OPENAI_API_KEY =your-openai-api-key
```

### [​](#step-3-basic-usage) Step 3: Basic Usage

The simplest way to get started with Tavily Search:

```
import { tavilySearch } from "@tavily/ai-sdk"; import { tavilySearch } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText, stepCountIs } from "ai"; import { generateText, stepCountIs } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "What are the latest developments in quantum computing?", prompt:  "What are the latest developments in quantum computing?", tools: { tools: { tavilySearch: tavilySearch(), tavilySearch:  tavilySearch(), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(3), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(3),});}); console.log(result.text); console. log(result. text);
```

## [​](#available-tools) Available Tools

### [​](#tavily-search) Tavily Search

Real-time web search optimized for AI applications:

```
import { tavilySearch } from "@tavily/ai-sdk"; import { tavilySearch } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText, stepCountIs } from "ai"; import { generateText, stepCountIs } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Research the latest trends in renewable energy technology", prompt:  "Research the latest trends in renewable energy technology", tools: { tools: { tavilySearch: tavilySearch({ tavilySearch:  tavilySearch({ searchDepth: "advanced", searchDepth:  "advanced", includeAnswer: true, includeAnswer:  true, maxResults: 5, maxResults:  5, topic: "general", topic:  "general", }), }), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(3), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(3),});});
```

**Key Configuration Options:**

* `searchDepth?: "basic" | "advanced"` - Search depth (default: “basic”)
* `topic?: "general" | "news" | "finance"` - Search category
* `includeAnswer?: boolean` - Include AI-generated answer
* `maxResults?: number` - Maximum results to return (default: 5)
* `includeImages?: boolean` - Include images in results
* `timeRange?: "year" | "month" | "week" | "day"` - Time range for results
* `includeDomains?: string[]` - Domains to include
* `excludeDomains?: string[]` - Domains to exclude

### [​](#tavily-extract) Tavily Extract

Clean, structured content extraction from URLs:

```
import { tavilyExtract } from "@tavily/ai-sdk"; import { tavilyExtract } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText } from "ai"; import { generateText } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Extract and summarize the content from https://tavily.com", prompt: "Extract and summarize the content from https://tavily.com", tools: { tools: { tavilyExtract: tavilyExtract(), tavilyExtract:  tavilyExtract(), }, },});});
```

**Key Configuration Options:**

* `extractDepth?: "basic" | "advanced"` - Extraction depth
* `format?: "markdown" | "text"` - Output format (default: “markdown”)
* `includeImages?: boolean` - Include images in extracted content

### [​](#tavily-crawl) Tavily Crawl

Intelligent website crawling at scale:

```
import { tavilyCrawl } from "@tavily/ai-sdk"; import { tavilyCrawl } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText } from "ai"; import { generateText } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Crawl tavily.com and tell me about their integrations", prompt: "Crawl tavily.com and tell me about their integrations", tools: { tools: { tavilyCrawl: tavilyCrawl({ tavilyCrawl:  tavilyCrawl({ maxDepth: 2, maxDepth:  2, limit: 50, limit:  50, }), }), }, },});});
```

**Key Configuration Options:**

* `maxDepth?: number` - Maximum crawl depth (1-5, default: 1)
* `maxBreadth?: number` - Maximum pages per depth level (1-100, default: 20)
* `limit?: number` - Maximum total pages to crawl (default: 50)
* `extractDepth?: "basic" | "advanced"` - Content extraction depth
* `instructions?: string` - Natural language crawling instructions
* `selectPaths?: string[]` - Path patterns to include
* `excludePaths?: string[]` - Path patterns to exclude
* `allowExternal?: boolean` - Allow crawling external domains

### [​](#tavily-map) Tavily Map

Website structure discovery and mapping:

```
import { tavilyMap } from "@tavily/ai-sdk"; import { tavilyMap } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText, stepCountIs } from "ai"; import { generateText, stepCountIs } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Map the structure of tavily.com", prompt: "Map the structure of tavily.com", tools: { tools: { tavilyMap: tavilyMap(), tavilyMap:  tavilyMap(), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(3), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(3),});});
```

**Key Configuration Options:**

* `maxDepth?: number` - Maximum mapping depth (1-5, default: 1)
* `maxBreadth?: number` - Maximum pages per depth level (1-100, default: 20)
* `limit?: number` - Maximum total pages to map (default: 50)
* `instructions?: string` - Natural language mapping instructions
* `selectPaths?: string[]` - Path patterns to include
* `excludePaths?: string[]` - Path patterns to exclude
* `allowExternal?: boolean` - Allow mapping external domains

## [​](#using-multiple-tools-together) Using Multiple Tools Together

You can combine multiple Tavily tools in a single AI agent for comprehensive research capabilities:

```
import { import {  tavilySearch,  tavilySearch,  tavilyExtract,  tavilyExtract,  tavilyCrawl,  tavilyCrawl,  tavilyMap  tavilyMap  } from "@tavily/ai-sdk";} from "@tavily/ai-sdk";import { generateText, stepCountIs } from "ai"; import { generateText, stepCountIs } from  "ai";import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai"; const result = await generateText({const  result =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Research the company at tavily.com - search for news, map their site, and extract key pages", prompt: "Research the company at tavily.com - search for news, map their site, and extract key pages", tools: { tools: { tavilySearch: tavilySearch({ searchDepth: "advanced" }), tavilySearch:  tavilySearch({ searchDepth:  "advanced" }), tavilyExtract: tavilyExtract(), tavilyExtract:  tavilyExtract(), tavilyCrawl: tavilyCrawl(), tavilyCrawl:  tavilyCrawl(), tavilyMap: tavilyMap(), tavilyMap:  tavilyMap(), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(5), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(5),});});
```

## [​](#advanced-examples) Advanced Examples

### [​](#news-research-with-time-range) News Research with Time Range

```
const newsResult = await generateText({const  newsResult =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "What are the top technology news stories from this week?", prompt:  "What are the top technology news stories from this week?", tools: { tools: { tavilySearch: tavilySearch({ tavilySearch:  tavilySearch({ topic: "news", topic:  "news", timeRange: "week", timeRange:  "week", maxResults: 10, maxResults:  10, }), }), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(3), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(3),});});
```

### [​](#market-analysis-with-advanced-search) Market Analysis with Advanced Search

```
const marketResult = await generateText({const  marketResult =  await  generateText({ model: openai("gpt-5-mini"), model:  openai("gpt-5-mini"), prompt: "Analyze the current state of the electric vehicle market", prompt:  "Analyze the current state of the electric vehicle market", tools: { tools: { tavilySearch: tavilySearch({ tavilySearch:  tavilySearch({ searchDepth: "advanced", searchDepth:  "advanced", topic: "finance", topic:  "finance", includeAnswer: true, includeAnswer:  true, maxResults: 10, maxResults:  10, }), }), }, }, stopWhen: stepCountIs(5), stopWhen:  stepCountIs(5),});});
```

## [​](#benefits-of-tavily-+-vercel-ai-sdk) Benefits of Tavily + Vercel AI SDK

* **Pre-built Tools:** No need to manually create tool definitions - just import and use
* **Type-Safe:** Full TypeScript support with proper type definitions
* **Real-time Information:** Access up-to-date web content for your AI agents
* **Optimized for LLMs:** Search results are specifically formatted for language models
* **Multiple Capabilities:** Search, extract, crawl, and map websites - all in one package
* **Easy Integration:** Works seamlessly with Vercel AI SDK v5
* **Flexible Configuration:** Extensive configuration options for all tools
* **Production-Ready:** Built on the reliable Tavily API infrastructure
